method_notes: offset -12; question side pdf 27-28 (q1-6 on 27, q7-26 on 28); answer side pdf 78-80 (q1-18 on 78, q19-25 on 79, q26 on 80)

section-I keys letter+text -> option by printed letter (addendum §4.1). q2 key 'December 10, 1948' reorders vs option C '10 December 1948' (same date, word order) -> typo/word-order flag, letter C kept (register garbled-key-text). q1,3-9 valid, text agrees

key-lines self-count (relay 10): sub-headed keys printed lines = stored steps + 1 (the heading line, not a step); plain bullet keys printed==stored; vsa 10-13 single-value (wrapped); no drops
sections I/II no marks, III '(2/3 marks questions)', IV '(3/4 Marks Questions)' -> all 26 marks null+flag (addendum §4.5)
